title: jennifer garner shows off minimalist wood and white kitchen
seoTitle: Jennifer Garner's Minimalist Wood & White Kitchen
subtitle: the actress inspires with Scandinavian design and natural materials
excerpt: Jennifer Garner revealed her home kitchen, combining white cabinets with wood paneling that brings warmth and texture to the space.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Actress Jennifer Garner is in the spotlight for revealing her home kitchen, where white cabinets combine with wood paneling that brings warmth and texture to the space. The choice of materials and visual continuity make the space an example of warm minimalism in 2027.

white and wood kitchen brings warmth to minimalism

Garner's kitchen maintains white cabinets to create a contemporary look, while wooden beams and floor-to-ceiling wood paneling add weight and warmth, preventing the space from feeling sterile.

modern textures instead of flat finishes

Matt Phillips, UK Head of Operations at Rotpunkt, states that designers are increasingly seeking textured materials instead of flat finishes. Garner's space offers a beautiful blueprint for this movement.

accessories that unite beauty and functionality

  • acacia wood serving platter with a natural finish, ideal for daily use and entertaining;
  • Fraxinus wood utensil set with ergonomic handles;
  • white marble backpack to display and use;
  • natural wood salad serving bowl with a tactile texture;
  • white marble utensil holder that adds subtle texture;
  • wooden cutting board, both functional and decorative.

emphasis on quality raw materials

Matt highlights that the kitchen is in a moment of emphasis on quality raw materials, offering a warm and contemporary minimalist style. He recommends mixing light and dark woods, wood and glass designs, and metallic decorations to create a connection with nature.

natural walnut wood in the spotlight

Matt recommends natural walnut in tones of creamy white, light brown, and dark chocolate as the wood of choice for the season, with oak as an alternative for variety and texture.

visual coherence throughout the kitchen

Wood is used consistently, extending from the cabinetry to the wall and the ceiling, creating continuity and avoiding an overly rustic look. The combination of wood and white cabinets keeps the space modern and clean.

inspiring those seeking Scandinavian design with depth

Garner demonstrates that a wooden kitchen can be minimalist without looking rustic, using wood in a restrained and continuous way to bring warmth to traditional Scandinavian design.

With information from Homes and Gardens.
